findings.claim: The shared starter and test plan cannot produce a passing declared test command for the Standard S27 route. The base starter is intentionally required to fail increment 1, all four increment directories are included by the declared unfiltered `npm test`, and Standard learners perform only increment 4. `npm test -- increment-4` merely filters Vitest to paths containing `increment-4`; passing it does not make the declared `npm test` pass, because the unimplemented increment 1-3 tests still run. This also omits prior-increment regression coverage on the Fast route. The plan therefore does not yet define a testable single canonical project for both overlays under the lab contract's one-command and passing-completion requirements.

evidence.section: Filtering by File Name: a CLI filename pattern runs only test files whose path contains the string
Sections 3 and 6: exactly one declared test command; on completion its test summary matches expected output

findings.recommendation: Before authoring, define route-aware test state within the one canonical artifact so `npm test` passes after the Standard increment-4 route and each Fast increment checks all outcomes completed through that point without running future tests. For example, make the one command read an explicit learner-updated route/progress setting and select Standard increment 4 or cumulative Fast increments 1..N. Keep public tests, one artifact and one command; do not commit completed Fast work as a Standard baseline solution or duplicate the project by track. Record the exact starter state, selection mechanism and expected summaries for both routes, then exercise both routes in the authoring gate.

findings.claim: Increment 3 says to handle form submission and per-record deletion through one listener attached to the record list. Bubbling reaches ancestors of the event target, not unrelated elements or descendants. In the described scaffold the add form and record list are separate named page elements, so a submit event targeted at the form is not guaranteed to pass through a listener on the list; the planned instruction is not executable without an unstated and awkward containment structure.

evidence.section: Introducing event bubbling; Setting a listener on a parent element; Event delegation

findings.recommendation: Specify a submit listener on the form plus one delegated click listener on the record list, or attach one listener to an explicit common ancestor and teach how both events reach it. Align the scaffold DOM, worked snippet and public DOM tests with that event path.

findings.claim: Increment 2 applies `sortRecords(records, compare)` even though its teach step names callbacks, map, filter and reduce but never teaches sorting or comparator behavior. The obvious Array.prototype.sort implementation mutates the input array, conflicting with the increment's stated pure-logic outcome and adjacent explicit non-mutation requirement. As written, the plan neither teaches this additional behavior before application nor requires a non-mutating implementation.

evidence.section: Description; sort() returns the reference to the same array: sort mutates in place, while toSorted() or copying avoids mutation

findings.recommendation: Either remove `sortRecords` because sorting is not needed by the stated cumulative project, or add comparator and in-place-sort semantics to the immediately preceding teach-then-check step, require a copy-before-sort or `toSorted()` implementation, and add a public assertion that the input array is unchanged.
